t: Look up at the Shell Centre, a skyscraper on Belvedere Road in Lambeth. It's the global headquarters of the oil company Shell, and it stands on the South Bank of the Thames near County Hall, forming the backdrop to the London Eye. It was designed by Howard Robertson, an American-born British architect. He was President of the Royal Institute of British Architects from 1952 to 1954, a Royal Academician, and winner of the Royal Gold Medal for architecture in 1949.
